No floor, no sky, no ocean, no window, no buildings, no frame, no text. Preserve true alpha between branches and outside leaves.

conceptPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art direction concept for an explorable 3D game environment. Primary request: INSIDE YOUR ROOM — the inside of a handmade treehouse belonging to a skateboarder, skate paraphernalia all around, a clearly visible chunky BLACK 1990s CRT television, and separate paper posters tacked onto wooden walls. Create a polished wide 16:9 environment concept, no characters, no interface or text labels. Camera just inside the front of the room looking across a broad walkable timber floor toward the back and right walls. Interior design: intimate irregular honey-coloured reclaimed plank cabin wrapped around a living tree trunk, hefty exposed rafters, forest canopy visible through generous square windows, afternoon sunlight pools on the floor. A low worn daybed with a faded teal blanket, a patterned rug in the middle, a low timber cabinet with the black CRT and small game console/controller; recognisably deep black CRT casing, curved blue-green glass, speaker grille and buttons. Personal clutter at the edges: two assembled skateboards, three used decks on wall pegs, spare wheels/trucks, helmet, skate shoes, folded zines and cassette tapes. Artful original skate posters on walls, bold abstract screenprinted artwork without brand logos. The room feels lived in, calm and desirable, with handmade joinery, relaxed asymmetry, warm amber wood versus teal upholstery and green forest; high-end hand-painted stylized 3D adventure game environment, material richness, beautiful light and readable silhouettes, grounded furniture. Keep a large central navigable area. This is a full room view, not a collage, not a dollhouse exterior, not a photographic human bedroom.
